total_model.summary: Model projects 46.5 total points (WAS 21, LA 26). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 0.8), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 0.7), Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
